changelog:
- Initial release of daily-briefing: an automated daily morning briefing delivered via iMessage at 7am.
- Compiles weather, calendar events, top 5 news headlines, 3–4 AI/tech updates, OpenClaw insights, and actionable workflow tips.
- Highly customizable via `config.yaml` for location, news/AI sources, delivery time, and preferences.
- Provides manual scripts for generating and sending the briefing, as well as full cron integration.
- Troubleshooting and extension ideas documented for easy maintenance and future improvements.
